question.text:
System1 Group's Test Your Ad shows each new UK TV ad to a nationally representative sample of UK adults, measures their second-by-second emotional response and publishes a Star Rating from 1.0 to 5.9 stars (one decimal) that predicts the ad's long-term brand-building potential. What Star Rating will System1 publish for the following UK Christmas 2026 ad? Ad description:
Brand: Barbour (UK)
Ad title: Barbour x Wallace & Gromit | Barbour Christmas Film 2026
Released: 5 November 2026 (brand online release; TV slot: not stated)
Length of the main edit: 90 seconds
Format: stop-motion
Setting: Wallace's house at Christmas; snowy countryside with dry-stone walls and a signpost reading "Tripton Fell" and "Barbour Way".
Characters: Wallace and Gromit (licensed Aardman characters, returning from Barbour's previous Christmas collaboration); a sheep appears in the key art. Other characters and voice cast: not stated.
Story:
1. Gromit sits by the Christmas tree holding a wrapped present.
2. Wallace sets out on a Christmas Day walk riding one of his new inventions, a tracked machine with an armchair seat, with Gromit walking alongside.
3. Wallace says it is time to head back for the turkey.
4. The walk goes wrong.
5. Gromit, with the help of Barbour, comes to the rescue. Ending: not stated.
Music: not stated.
Dialogue and voiceover: Wallace (subtitled): "Merry Christmas! Lovely day for a peaceful walk, eh!" and "Oh we better be headed back... the turkey'll be done!"
Tone: comedic, nostalgic
Brand and product presence: Both are "wrapped up in Barbour": Wallace in a knitted hat, tartan scarf and wellingtons, Gromit in a dog coat. Key art shows "Wallace & Gromit x Barbour". End line: not stated.
